description: License policy for the NaviVeylin build. The gate evaluates every SBOM
component against this file and fails the build on a missing identifier, an
unresolved choice, or a license outside the permitted set for the component's
distribution scope.
`permitted.shipped` applies to components whose code is distributed in the APK;
`permitted.buildTimeOnly` applies to build tooling and libraries that contribute
no shipped binary. The two lists are deliberately separate so that a build-time
license which must not be distributed (for example a GPL build tool) cannot
silently become a shipped license: moving a component between scopes moves it
between lists, and a shipped component missing from `permitted.shipped` fails.
`elections` records, per component, the license actually relied upon where the
component's expression offers a choice. An election must resolve to alternatives
the expression offers; a component with a choice and no election fails the gate.
`reviewRequired` lists licenses that need the application license decision before
distribution; the gate reports them and never treats presence in this file as
clearance. This file states what the build permits - it is not a legal opinion.
`licenseRefs` declares identifiers for licenses that have no SPDX identifier:
such a license may only be reported through a declared `LicenseRef-` entry, an
undeclared non-SPDX license fails the gate, and `textDistributed: false` means the
license screen links to `source` instead of embedding text.
The application's own license is undecided (LICENSE is a bare GPLv2 text and
README.md says "License information TBD"); the shipped set below records what is
in use today, not a settled position.

LicenseRef-AndroidSDK.name: Android Software Development Kit License
LicenseRef-AndroidSDK.reason: Google's SDK terms carry no SPDX identifier; the artifacts declare only a license name and a URL. The license screen links to the canonical terms instead of embedding a copy, which would redistribute a third party's terms and age silently.

LicenseRef-NaviVeylin.name: NaviVeylin project license
LicenseRef-NaviVeylin.reason: First-party code. The project's own license is undecided (LICENSE is a bare GPLv2 text and README.md says 'License information TBD'), so first-party components carry a declared LicenseRef rather than being exempted from the rules the third-party components follow.

cairo.reason: MPL-1.1 is a permissive-choice alternative to LGPL-2.1-only and avoids the LGPL relinking obligation for a statically linked library.

freetype.reason: The FreeType License requires attribution only; GPL-2.0-or-later would impose copyleft on a shipped library.

glib.reason: Keeps glib under its own LGPL terms instead of the MPL alternative offered for a subset of files. Build-time only, so no distribution consequence.

marisa-trie.reason: BSD-2-Clause avoids copyleft for a library statically linked into the shipped libosmscout shared object.

reviewRequired.note: The project's own license is undecided (LICENSE is a bare GPLv2 text, README.md says 'License information TBD').

libosmscout is distributed as separate shared objects and its stated license is LGPL while its LICENSE file carries GPLv2 text (see native-license-map.json caveat). Needs the application license decision.
